page.title: Surveys
page.subtitle: Create and publish workspace surveys without duration, scores, or proctoring.
page.emptyHint: Start by creating your first survey.
page.assignedEmpty: No surveys are assigned to you yet.
page.assignedHint: When a survey you can answer is published, it will appear here.

audience.title: Audience
audience.subtitle: Choose who can respond to this survey.
audience.communityDesc: Any signed-in QuizHub user, including people outside this workspace.
audience.workspaceDesc: Every active member: student, teacher, and admin.
audience.targetedDesc: Only the people you select before publishing.
audience.lockedHint: Audience cannot be changed after publishing.

kind.title: What do you want to create?
kind.surveyDesc: Collect responses with no duration, scores, or proctoring.

confirm.archiveMessage: Archive this survey? It will be hidden from active lists.
confirm.archiveNote: You can return to it later from the archive if available.
confirm.closeMessage: Close this survey now? No one will be able to respond afterward.
confirm.closeNote: Closing stops new responses. Submitted responses stay as they are.
confirm.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this survey?
confirm.deleteNote: Deletion is permanent and may not be reversible from the interface.

toast.targetedRequired: A targeted survey needs at least one assigned member before publishing.

basicInfo.title: Survey basics
basicInfo.subtitle: Add a title and description. Subject is optional.
basicInfo.descriptionPlaceholder: Write a short intro respondents will see.
basicInfo.subjectHint: Link the survey to a subject when relevant, or leave it unlinked.

settings.title: Audience and closing date
settings.subtitle: Choose who can respond, and optionally when the survey closes.
settings.closedAtHint: Leave empty to keep it open until you close it manually.

review.title: Review before publishing
review.subtitle: Check the questions and audience. There are no scores or duration.

publish.title: Publish and share the link
publish.subtitle: Publish the survey, then copy the link for respondents.
publish.shareHint: This link can be shared. Community respondents do not need to join the workspace.
publish.assignHint: Choose who can respond to this survey.
publish.identityNote: Responses are associated with respondent accounts (name and email).

respond.introMessage: Press Start to open the questions. You can save and submit later.
respond.submitMessage: Submit this survey now? You will not be able to edit answers after submitting.
respond.submitMessagePartial: You still have {{count}} unanswered question(s). Submit now?
respond.completedMessage: Thank you for participating. You can review your answers below without editing.

toast.nothingToSave: Answer at least one question before saving

responses.title: View responses
responses.subtitle: Response summary for “{{name}}” — no academic scores.

detail.title: Response details
detail.emptyAnswers: No answers saved for this response yet.
